'''Sephi''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] indigenous to [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]]. Although they had been members of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and friends of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] of the Sephi sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Sephi_aide.png|thumb|left|A young female Sephi]]
The Sephi were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Outwardly, they were very similar in appearance to [[Human/Legends|Human]] stock, the key difference being their long, pointed [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. Like most humanoids, the Sephi came in two [[Gender/Legends|sexes]], male and female; with the latter being distinguished by more prominent [[Breast/Legends|breasts]] and a different [[Hair/Legends|hairline]].<ref name="JY" /> Many Sephi were tall and healthy-looking, with a narrow waistline and long-fingered hands. However, smaller and overweight individuals were not unheard of.<ref name="JY" />

While many Sephi had pale, [[Color/Legends|purplish]] skin,<ref name="JY" /> some had more Human-like skintones.<ref name="VQ" /> Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] came in the colors black<ref name="JY" /> or brown.<ref name="VQ" /> Their long, straight hair ranged in color from black<ref name="JY" /> through blond<ref name="VQ" /> to gray and white. Depending on personal status, it was common for upper-class Sephi to fashion their hair into thick spirals adorned with [[gem]]stones and other decorations, making it a source of personal pride. Males also had a distinct widow's peak, in addition to a receding hairline.<ref name="JY" /> The female hairline, however, formed an upside down U and was located closer to the eyebrows.<ref name="VQ" />

The Sephi were a long-lived [[Species/Legends|species]], with elder individuals living for more than 200 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], possibly up to 400.<ref name="JY" /> They could [[Hybrid/Legends|interbreed]] with several other species, including the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanians]]<ref name="KOTOR48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref> and the Humans.<ref name="Guide">In ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', it was stated that the part-Sephi [[Bertroff Hissa]] had "a bit of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]] running through his veins." Since the word "alien" is used by opposition to [[Human/Legends|Human]], Hissa must have been part-Human, part-Sephi.</ref>

==Society and culture==
[[File:Sephi-concept.jpg|thumb|right|300px|From left: King [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]], Senator [[Navi]], [[Moje]], [[Senatorial aide]] [[Lirka]], Sephi Sentry, Sephi Military Soldier.]]
The Sephi formed a [[Technology level|space-level]] civilization led by a [[King/Legends|monarch]]. Due to the species' longevity, Sephi sovereigns tended to stay in place for a long time. They had developed a culture of elegance and sophistication in art, which was even reflected in the delicate design of their walkers, flyers and tanks.<ref name="JY" />

==History==
The Sephi evolved on [[Thustra/Legends|Thustra]], a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Thustra system/Legends|eponymous]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> of the [[Sumitra sector/Legends|Sumitra sector]],<ref name="AOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> They had contacts with the wider [[galactic community]], or at least with the Arkanians, since at least the fifth millennium before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="KOTOR48" />

At some point in their history, the Sephi joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a democratic government that spanned a vast expanse of the galaxy. For centuries, they stood as staunch defenders of the Republic, and the Sephi monarch exerted a powerful influence over the neighboring systems. They were also in good terms with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]],<ref name="JY" /> a group of enlightened warriors who acted as the guardians of peace and justice in the Republic.<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> Around [[222 BBY/Legends|222 BBY]], the Sephi king [[Alaric (Sephi)|Alaric]] befriended [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Grand Master of the Order.<ref name="JY" />

However, in the third [[Standard month/Legends|month]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a separatist union led by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sixteen months after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], King Alaric chose to rally Dooku in response to the rampant corruption of the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Yoda, who was an old friend of Alaric, was forced to lead a clone army against the Sephi forces. While the Jedi sought to end the conflict peacefully, Alaric unwaveringly refused to change his allegiance. In the mean time, the loyalist but corrupt [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Navi]], who represented the Sephi in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], tried to manipulate the Republic into restoring order on Thustra through military force. To that end, he tricked the Republic into attacking the Sephi forces, making them think they had killed Yoda.<ref name="JY" /> During the conflict, clones suprised attacked Sephi forces based on Navi's lies, Yoda was then betrayed by King Alaric, firing a blaster to be deflected by Yoda into Alaric's heart. Senator Navi was then arrested for conspiracy, Moje got away successfully.

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Do you have a species for Valentha Farfalla in the Holocron?''"<br />"''Not concretely. For the longest time we've used dozens of pointy-eared characters without a species name for them. The pointed-eared species in the Jedi: Yoda comic were named Sephi. My theory is that all pointy-eared species are either Sephi or closely related to Sephi.|J. Ral'Tir and Leland Chee on the StarWars.com Message Boards, June 08, 2007|<ref name="TT">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1395#16675997|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Tasty Taste]]|date=2007-06-08|time=6:48 AM}}</ref>}}
[[Leland Chee]], on the [[StarWars.com Message Boards]], stated that his theory is that "all pointy-eared species are either Sephi or closely related to Sephi." Notice that he answered this when asked about Farfalla's species, who had equine features including hooves. Due to their pointed ears, it is possible that Jedi Masters [[Fay]] and [[Aleco Stusea]] might be Sephi.<ref name="TT" />
